verdict.rationale: The evidence covers only outbound vendor due diligence: sending security questionnaires to vendors and uploading questionnaire templates for vendor and AI-system reviews. That is an adjacent third-party-risk feature, not answering inbound customer questionnaires. Nothing in the pack shows Sprinto importing customer-sent SIG, CAIQ, portal or spreadsheet questionnaires, or exporting completed answers back in the customer's original format.
